user_decision: Cerrar investigación 3.5 y preparar etapa 4 sin fotón
summary: The missing information is the physical volumetric phonon DOS g_ph(E), not separate arbitrary normalizations of F and N. The available NbN shape remains useful; no absolute hotbelt or photon-latency admission follows.

new_evidence.fact: Headered Al, Nb, TiN tables integrate to 3.00074610, 5.98360199 and 6.01790853 on their stored THz axis. No universal normalization to three is inferable.
The missing _2 file is absent from every one of the 14 public historical trees; additional searches of that history are not required.
The kinetic combinations depend on g_ph=N_b F_b. Consistent reciprocal changes of the two factors are a basis convention; changing only one changes physics.
new_evidence.source: Own dimensional/algebraic derivation from the energy and electron-phonon kernels

new_evidence.fact: Upstream solver N=50 and tau_escape=10 ps differ from SI25 table N=48 and tau_escape=15 ps; neither collection is the selected Korzh80nm film calibration.
